title: Custom rules and ACL

controls.label: Custom rules
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: Shows the user's rule list and the Add rule(s) overflow menu.

controls.label: Toolbar
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: Shows the screen title and the Add rule(s) menu. Its navigation icon opens the drawer. In the selection action mode the contextual bar replaces its content.

controls.label: Custom rules
controls.visible_when: no selection action mode is active
controls.action: Shows the screen title, set from R.string.custom_rules.

controls.label: Open navigation drawer
controls.visible_when: no selection action mode is active
controls.action: Opens the navigation drawer from the start edge.

controls.label: Add rule(s)…
controls.visible_when: no selection action mode is active
controls.action: Opens the submenu with Manual Settings, Import from Clipboard, and GFW List.

controls.label: Manual Settings
controls.visible_when: the Add rule(s) submenu is open
controls.action: Opens the Edit rule dialog with the Generic template selected and an empty input.

controls.label: Import from Clipboard
controls.visible_when: the Add rule(s) submenu is open
controls.action: Parses the clipboard text as an ACL. It adds its proxy hostnames and proxy URLs, and its subnets only when the parsed default is bypass. Bypass hostnames and bypass subnets are dropped. It reports Failed to import when nothing is added or the parse throws.

controls.label: GFW List
controls.visible_when: the Add rule(s) submenu is open
controls.action: Reads the gfwlist ACL file from noBackupFilesDir. Core copies that file from the bundled asset, and AclSyncer can replace it with the copy from shadowsocks.org, so it is not necessarily the bundled list. Adds its subnets when the file default is bypass, then its proxy hostnames and URLs.

controls.label: Rule list
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: Shows subnets first, then proxy hostnames, then URLs. A START swipe on a row removes it when the swipe gate allows and no selection is active. The list has a fast scroller.

controls.label: Rule row
controls.visible_when: the ACL has at least one entry
controls.action: A tap opens the Edit rule dialog when no selection is active. A long press toggles selection. A START swipe on the row removes it when the swipe gate allows and no selection is active.

controls.label: Rule text
controls.visible_when: the ACL has at least one entry
controls.action: Shows the rule: the subnet as Subnet.toString(), the hostname as stored, or the URL as URL.toString(). The row layout is android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1.

controls.label: Fast scroll handle
controls.visible_when: the list is longer than the screen
controls.action: Drags the list; a popup shows the leading letter at the position.

controls.label: Selection action mode
controls.visible_when: selectedItems is not empty
controls.action: The contextual ActionMode started by toolbar.startActionMode. It replaces the toolbar content with Select all, Cut, Copy, and Remove until the selection is empty.

controls.label: Select all
controls.visible_when: the selection action mode is active
controls.action: Selects every subnet, hostname, and URL in the list.

controls.label: Cut
controls.visible_when: the selection action mode is active
controls.action: Copies the selected rules as ACL text, then removes them.

controls.label: Copy
controls.visible_when: the selection action mode is active
controls.action: Copies the selected rules as ACL text to the clipboard.

controls.label: Remove
controls.visible_when: the selection action mode is active
controls.action: Removes the selected rules and shows the undo snackbar.

controls.label: Undo
controls.visible_when: C-U06-015 is shown
controls.action: Restores every rule held in the recycle bin, newest removal first, and clears the bin.

controls.label: Removed / %d items removed
controls.visible_when: a rule was removed by swipe, by Cut, by Remove in the action mode, or by Remove in the dialog
controls.action: Shows the recycle bin size, so a second removal while it is shown reports the combined count. Dismissing it keeps the removals.

controls.label: Edit rule
controls.visible_when: a rule row is tapped, Manual Settings is used, or an existing rule is opened
controls.action: Edits one rule with a template selector, one text field, OK, Cancel, and Remove.

controls.label: Subnet or Hostname PCRE pattern / Domain name and all its subdomain names / URL to online config
controls.visible_when: the Edit rule dialog is open
controls.action: Switches the template and re-runs validation.

controls.label: Rule text
controls.visible_when: the Edit rule dialog is open
controls.action: Takes the subnet, pattern, domain, or URL. Each change re-runs validation.

controls.label: Validation error
controls.visible_when: validation produced a message
controls.action: Shows the parse message, or the cleartext HTTP warning.

controls.label: OK
controls.visible_when: the Edit rule dialog is open
controls.enabled_when: the current template accepts the current text
controls.action: Adds the rule, replacing the item the dialog was opened for.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.visible_when: the Edit rule dialog is open
controls.action: Closes the dialog and changes nothing.

controls.label: Remove
controls.visible_when: the dialog opened for a non-empty existing rule
controls.action: Removes the rule and offers it back through the undo snackbar.

controls.label: Successfully export!
controls.visible_when: Core.trySetPrimaryClip returns true for Copy or Cut
controls.action: Confirms the copy.

controls.label: Failed to export.
controls.visible_when: Core.trySetPrimaryClip returns false for Copy or Cut because it caught a RuntimeException
controls.action: Reports the failed copy. Cut still removes the selected rules.

controls.label: Failed to import.
controls.visible_when: the clipboard text yields no rule or parsing throws
controls.action: Reports the failed import.

controls.label: Custom rules
controls.visible_when: the navigation drawer is open
controls.action: Replaces the fragment with the Custom rules screen through MainActivity.displayFragment and closes the drawer.

cases.title: Open Custom rules from the drawer
preconditions: the app is on the profiles screen
the navigation drawer is closed
expected: the drawer lists Custom rules between Subscriptions and Settings
the Custom rules screen shows the rule list and the Add rule(s) menu
the drawer closes

cases.title: Add a subnet through Manual Settings
preconditions: the Custom rules screen is open
expected: the Edit rule dialog opens with an empty input and the Generic template
OK becomes enabled
the list gains a row showing 10.0.0.0/8
custom-rules-user.acl contains the new rule

cases.title: Generic template rejects an invalid pattern and recovers
preconditions: the Edit rule dialog is open on the Generic template
steps: Read the OK button and the error line
Replace the text with a valid pattern
expected: OK is disabled and the error line shows the regex message
OK becomes enabled once the text compiles
the rule is added to the list

cases.title: Domain template stores an anchored pattern
preconditions: the Edit rule dialog is open
expected: OK is enabled
the new row shows (?:^|\.)example\.com$ with escaped dots and the trailing $
opening that row again shows the Domain template and example.com in Unicode

cases.title: URL template warns on cleartext http
preconditions: the Edit rule dialog is open
expected: OK is enabled
the error line shows the cleartext HTTP warning for http and clears for https
the URL appears in the list

cases.title: Edit an existing rule and save it
preconditions: the rule list holds example.com as a Domain rule
expected: the dialog opens with the Domain template and example.com
the old row is removed and the new rule is added
the list scrolls to the new row and the file holds example.org

cases.title: Remove a rule from the edit dialog
preconditions: the rule list holds example.com
expected: the dialog shows the Domain template with example.com and a Remove button
the row leaves the list and the snackbar says Removed
Undo restores the rule

cases.title: Import rules from the clipboard
preconditions: the clipboard holds an ACL text with a proxy list
expected: the proxy hostnames and proxy URLs of the clipboard text appear as rows
the edited file holds them

cases.title: Import fails on a clipboard with no rule
preconditions: the clipboard holds text that parses to no entry
expected: the list is unchanged
the snackbar says Failed to import

cases.title: Import the bundled GFW list in one tap
preconditions: the rule list is empty
expected: subnets from the gfwlist file in noBackupFilesDir appear first
hostname patterns and URLs follow
custom-rules-user.acl holds the added entries

cases.title: Swipe a row away and undo it
preconditions: the list holds three rules
no selection is active
the service is stopped or the route is not custom-rules
steps: Swipe the middle row toward the start
expected: the row leaves the list immediately
the snackbar shows the removed count and Undo
Undo puts the row back

cases.title: Swipe does nothing while a selection is active
preconditions: the list holds three rules
one rule is selected
steps: Swipe a second row toward the start
expected: the row does not move
the selection stays as it was

cases.title: Swipe is blocked while the custom-rules route runs
preconditions: the service state is Connected
the current profile uses the custom-rules route
steps: Swipe a row toward the start
Leave the screen and stop the service from the profiles screen or its notification
Open Custom rules again and swipe the same row
expected: the row does not move while the service runs
the row is removed after the service stops
row taps, dialog OK and Remove, and Cut and Remove still work while the service runs, because the gate is read only by getSwipeDirs

cases.title: Long press starts the selection and tap toggles
preconditions: the list holds two rules
expected: the action mode appears with one rule selected
the second row is added to the selection and no dialog opens
the first row is deselected and the action mode stays
the last row is deselected and the action mode ends

cases.title: Select all and copy the rules as ACL
preconditions: the list holds a subnet, a hostname, and a URL
expected: every row is selected
the clipboard holds an ACL text with a bypass default and the proxy list
the snackbar says Successfully export

cases.title: Cut removes the selection after copying
preconditions: the list holds two rules
both rules are selected
steps: Read the list and the snackbar
expected: both rules leave the list
the clipboard holds both rules
the snackbar shows 2 items removed with Undo

cases.title: Back ends the action mode and keeps the rules
preconditions: two rules are selected
expected: the toolbar returns and the selection clears
the screen stays open and the rules remain

cases.title: Remove selected rules and read the count
preconditions: the list holds three rules
expected: both rules leave the list
the snackbar says 2 items removed and offers Undo

cases.title: Connect with the custom-rules route
preconditions: the current profile uses the custom-rules route
custom-rules-user.acl holds a list URL
expected: the imported entries are fetched and saved into custom-rules.acl
the tunnel connects with the custom rules applied
a second connect rewrites custom-rules.acl from the user file

cases.title: Custom rules default is forced to bypass
preconditions: custom-rules-user.acl begins with proxy_all and holds one subnet
expected: the editor reads the file with bypass set and the subnet dropped
the file handed to the core starts with a bypass default

cases.title: A failing import URL aborts the connect
preconditions: the current profile uses the custom-rules route
custom-rules-user.acl holds an import URL that throws IOException
steps: Read the service state and the message
expected: BaseService catches the IOException while flattening and stops the start
the service shows the service-failed message and no tunnel is established

cases.title: A malformed IMPORT_URL line fails the start
preconditions: custom-rules-user.acl holds a #IMPORT_URL line with a value that is not a URL
steps: Read the service state and the message
expected: Acl.parse calls URL with the malformed value and throws MalformedURLException
the start fails with the service-failed message

cases.title: A preset ACL refresh retries and then fails
preconditions: the route is gfwlist
the download throws IOException on every attempt
steps: Wait for AclSyncer to run more than five times
expected: each attempt returns retry while runAttemptCount is 5 or less
the attempt after runAttemptCount becomes 6 returns failure

cases.title: Preset ACL files are deployed for the core
preconditions: the app has just been updated
steps: Start a service whose route is gfwlist
expected: every file in assets/acl is copied into noBackupFilesDir
the command line holds --acl followed by the path of gfwlist.acl
a route of all adds no --acl argument

cases.title: An empty Generic rule is stored as an empty row
preconditions: the Edit rule dialog was opened from Manual Settings
expected: OK is enabled because an empty text compiles as a pattern
the list gains an empty hostname row and custom-rules-user.acl gains an empty line
the reopened dialog shows no Remove button because the item is empty

cases.title: Cancel and dismissal leave the list unchanged
preconditions: the Edit rule dialog was opened for an existing rule
steps: Open the same rule again, change the text, and dismiss the dialog
expected: neither Cancel nor a dismissal returns an edit result
the rule and the list are unchanged

cases.title: Manual Settings shows no Remove button
preconditions: the rule list holds at least one rule
expected: the dialog shows OK and Cancel
the Remove button is absent because the argument item is null

cases.title: Dismissing the undo snackbar keeps the removal
preconditions: a rule was removed and its snackbar is visible
steps: Wait until the snackbar dismisses without the Undo action
expected: the removedCallback runs with a dismissal event other than action
the recycle bin is cleared and the rule does not return

cases.title: Leaving the screen flushes the snackbar and ends the action mode
preconditions: a removal snackbar is visible
two rules are selected in the action mode
expected: onDetach flushes the snackbar
the action mode ends and its selection is cleared

cases.title: A second removal joins the undo snackbar
preconditions: one rule was removed and its snackbar is visible
expected: the snackbar shows the combined count of two removals
one Undo restores both rules, newest removal first

cases.title: Cut removes the selection when the clipboard write fails
preconditions: two rules are selected
Core.trySetPrimaryClip returns false
steps: Read the list and the snackbar
expected: the snackbar says Failed to export
both rules still leave the list and the undo snackbar offers them back

cases.title: A proxy_all clipboard drops its subnets
preconditions: the clipboard holds [proxy_all], [proxy_list], and one subnet
steps: Read the list and the snackbar
expected: addToProxy adds subnets only when the parsed default is bypass, so the subnet is dropped
addToProxy returns null and the snackbar says Failed to import

cases.title: Changing the profile route opens the swipe gate
preconditions: the service is Connected with the custom-rules route
the list holds one rule
steps: Open Custom rules and swipe the row
Open the profile editor and change the route to all
Open Custom rules and swipe the row again
expected: the first swipe is refused because isEnabled is false
the second swipe removes the row because the route is no longer custom-rules

cases.title: A connect with no user file still writes the served ACL
preconditions: custom-rules-user.acl does not exist
the current profile uses the custom-rules route
steps: Read the file passed to the core
expected: Acl.customRules returns bypass with no entries
BaseService saves that as custom-rules.acl, which starts with [bypass_all]
the core receives custom-rules.acl

cases.title: An edit after a connect leaves the served ACL stale
preconditions: a custom-rules tunnel is connected
custom-rules.acl was written by that connect
steps: Add a rule in the editor
expected: the user file holds the new rule
custom-rules.acl still holds the previous rules until the next connect
the next connect rewrites custom-rules.acl from the user file

notes: All listed files exist. layout_custom_rules.xml includes plugin/src/main/res/layout/toolbar_light_dark.xml, so the toolbar comes from the plugin module. The Add rule(s) menu item (custom_rules_menu.xml:4) has no id; its submenu is addressed by position. C-U06-027 is the drawer entry owned by U01 and carries an empty parent because its parent lives in another unit; the route preference is U03's C-U03-013, so it is not repeated here. The toolbar navigation icon has no id of its own; the id toolbar belongs to the MaterialToolbar, modelled as C-U06-030. A domain rule is stored as (?:^|\.) with escaped dots and a trailing $, and the Domain read-back needs that trailing $. Swipe delete is an ItemTouchHelper attached to the list, not a button; the row and list actions describe it. The swipe gate is read only by getSwipeDirs, so row tap, dialog Remove, Cut, and Remove stay usable while the custom-rules route runs. A custom-rules start always reads the user file through the forced-bypass getter, flattens imports ten deep, and writes custom-rules.acl, with or without import URLs; the core never reads custom-rules-user.acl. A failing import URL or a malformed IMPORT_URL line aborts the Android start (BaseService.kt:370, Acl.kt:84), while the HarmonyOS port skips unreachable lists, so TC-U06-19, TC-U06-21, and TC-U06-22 diverge. AclSyncer refreshes only routes other than all and custom-rules (ProxyInstance.kt:135), waits for unmetered network and charging, and gives up after more than five attempts (AclSyncer.kt:79). The undo count is the recycle bin size, so a second removal before the snackbar ends reports the combined count and one Undo restores both batches. Cut removes the selection even when the clipboard write fails. Import adds subnets only when the parsed default is bypass. An empty Generic rule is valid and becomes an empty hostname row that reopens without a Remove button. The 5.4.0 port adds the per-rule editor, the Generic, Domain, and URL validation, the one-tap GFW List action, the drawer entry, and the undo bar. Three behaviors stay partial: a connect refreshes imported lists after the start for the next start, so the first connect serves the cached or unflattened file (TC-U06-19); a proxy-default file keeps its proxy-list subnets and drops only the bypass-list subnets (TC-U06-20); and the preset ACLs are read and deployed one route at a time at start and reach the core through the config's acl field, not a bulk noBackupFilesDir copy or a --acl command line (TC-U06-24). A failed import URL or a malformed IMPORT_URL line does not stop the start, and a refresh does not retry, so TC-U06-21, TC-U06-22, and TC-U06-23 are android-only platform divergences.
